## Tiebreaker Methods

When the CPO-STV algorithm reaches a tie situation, it applies tiebreakers in order. Each method has different properties.

### Borda Count

The Borda count assigns points based on rank positions. A first-place vote gives `n-1` points, second place `n-2`, etc. The candidate with the most total points wins.

### Random

A random draw using the configured seed. Reproducible but arbitrary.

### STV

Standard Sequential-Tally Voting elimination — eliminates the lowest-ranked candidate and redistributes.

### CPO-STV

Uses the CPO-STV algorithm itself as a tiebreaker. This can create nested elections but is the most principled choice.

## Ordering Matters

The order of tiebreakers in your rank list determines which method is tried first. For most elections, placing `Borda` first and `Random` last is recommended.
